experiences.title: Experience Library
experiences.pageHint: Store experiences for cover-letter generation. Merge similar ones; split different angles.
experiences.emptyHint: Add concrete project/integration/ops stories so recommendation and generation work better.
experiences.limitReached: You can save up to {{max}} experiences. Remove unused ones first.
experiences.guideMain: Detail beats volume. Role, description, and outcomes (numbers if real) work best.
experiences.guideSelect: In Workspace, picked experiences are split across sections. One deep experience per section works best.
experiences.guideReady: If status is not Ready, the model may invent details to fill gaps. Before generate: 80+ chars description, role, and outcome or situation–task–action–result.
experiences.readySummaryWarn: No experiences are ready for generation. Enrich fields below, then select them in the workspace.
experiences.formHint: One experience = one clear angle. Fill situation, role, and result—not just a title.
experiences.formRequiredForGen: For generation: description 80+ chars · role · (outcome or some situation–task–action–result)
experiences.typeHint: Project, tech, leadership, etc. help section-aware recommendations.
experiences.titleExample: e.g. CMS upgrade with SAP integration
experiences.descriptionExample: What, why, and how—without inventing numbers.
experiences.descriptionHint: Aim for 80+ characters so matching and writing have enough to go on.
experiences.resultExample: e.g. Shipped on schedule; automated inventory checks
experiences.numericResultHint: Only real numbers. Leave blank if none.
experiences.contributionExample: What you personally owned or decided
experiences.mapHint: The map starts at root and years. Click a node to expand its details on the map; double-click opens edit and AI. Use Expand all at the top right.
experiences.mapHintExpanded: Role, description, outcome, and skills are shown on every node. Double-click for the detail panel. Switch back with Compact view.
experiences.mapEmpty: No experiences to show on the map.
experiences.mapDetailHint: Click an activity node on the map.
experiences.chatHint: Talk through your experience, then save to the library.
experiences.chatEmpty: Describe your work in your own words—we'll organize title, role, results, and skills.
experiences.chatInputPlaceholder: Describe the project, your role, and outcomes…
experiences.chatContinueHint: A conversation is linked to this experience.

experiences.chatSuggest1: Which of my experiences fits a marketing role?
experiences.chatSuggest2: What's missing in my experience story?
experiences.chatSuggest3: Organize this as situation, task, action, and result

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.guide: ① Pick or enter a job posting → ② Set rewrite level & sections → ③ Generate all, or rewrite one section. Run interview, keyword compare, and diagnosis only when needed.
workspace.step1Hint: Select a saved or shared posting, or type the job description directly — only one is required.
workspace.writtenHint: “Written” means a cover letter was generated or saved for this posting.
workspace.historyPlaceholder: Select a cover letter to load
workspace.historyHint: Pick one from the list to load it.
workspace.jobTextDisabledPlaceholder: This field is unused while a saved posting is selected
workspace.jobTextDisabledHint: With a saved posting selected, its analyzed data is used automatically and this field is ignored.
workspace.recommendAutoHint: Recommendations refresh when the job posting changes, using company, role, and posting text. Low-match items are hidden.
workspace.recommendManualHint: Refresh after changing experiences or retrying a failure. Browse more via pages.
workspace.recommendEmpty: No experiences scored high enough for this posting. Enrich your library or check the job details.
workspace.recommendPageKeep: Selections are kept when you change pages.
workspace.preflightNeedSelect: Select at least one related experience.
workspace.preflightNeedReady: Title-only experiences cannot be used. Add description, role, and outcomes.
workspace.preflightThinWarn: Selected experiences need more detail. Confirm to continue — fabrication risk is higher.
workspace.preflightOk: Selected experiences look ready for generation.
workspace.preflightSectionShort: {{title}}: target {{target}} chars needs {{need}} experiences, but {{count}} assigned.
workspace.preflightRewriteHigh: Rewrite strength is high. Only wording should change; facts, numbers, and timeline must stay the same.
workspace.preflightThinConfirmDesc: Only thinly filled experiences are selected. The model may invent details to fill gaps. Prefer enriching the library first.
workspace.recommendedHint: Click to add as posting material. It is placed by matching the question title.
workspace.sectionTitlesDesc: Add the questions/titles required by the posting in order. Leave empty for the default structure. Set a target character count per section.
workspace.sectionTargetCharsHint: Ceiling · shorter if facts are thin
workspace.sectionRagRule: Deep experiences: 1 up to 1,200 chars · 2 for 1,201–2,000 · 3 for 2,001+. A career statement compresses 2–3 roles even when short.
workspace.experiencesPoolLimitHint: Posting material is at least the number of sections. 1 experience up to 1,200 chars, 2 for 1,201–2,000, 3 for 2,001+. Career statements compress 2–3 roles.
workspace.sectionExperienceLabel: Use in depth in this section
workspace.sectionExperienceHint: Pick different experiences per section. Unassigned material is only used to keep voice and facts consistent.
workspace.sectionExperienceAutoHint: When questions change, AI analyzes them first, then places the best-fitting experience. Change chips anytime; re-spread restores this placement.
workspace.consistencyHint: Sections still read as one person's letter. The same scene is not repeated.
workspace.step2Desc: Controls how strongly to rewrite wording and sentence structure. Facts, numbers, and timelines stay the same — 100% means full expression rewrite, not invention.
workspace.generateDraftHint: Output is a draft. Add missing decisions or tradeoffs to your experience library, then regenerate the section.
workspace.scoreNaturalnessDesc: Starts from 100 minus the AI-trace score, then trims a bit if sentence lengths are too uniform.
workspace.scoreCompanyFitDesc: How well the cover letter matches the job posting's role, culture, and required skills.
workspace.scoreStyleRetentionDesc: How much of the applicant's original tone and phrasing was preserved after rewriting.
workspace.scoreAiTracePercentDesc: Yellow and red sentences weighted by Korean word units (spaces). Consecutive flagged sentences, repetition, and sentence rhythm also count. Lower is better.
workspace.scoreStarApplicationDesc: How specifically experiences are told as situation, task, action, and result.
workspace.scoreExperienceUtilizationDesc: How specifically the experiences from your experience library are reflected in the cover letter.
workspace.resultEmpty: Set up the posting and section titles on the left, then click generate.
workspace.diagnosisDesc: Diagnoses naturalness and completeness sentence by sentence.
workspace.diagnosisEmpty: Generate a cover letter to see per-sentence diagnosis results.
workspace.sectionTitleCountMismatch: The number of section titles does not match the generated paragraphs. Check your titles or regenerate.
workspace.clearDraftDesc: Clears saved job input, AI results, and recommendations. This cannot be undone.
workspace.saveDialogDesc: Give it a name you can find later.
workspace.regenInstructionHint: Uses your selected experiences. Add emphasis or structure below — facts not in the library will not be invented.
workspace.regenInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. Expand the decision rationale for the customs outage, toward the target length
workspace.sectionEmpty: No content for this section yet.
workspace.humanizeHint: After writing, rewrite only yellow/red sentences to reduce AI tone. Facts and numbers stay the same.
workspace.humanizeReportOnly: No sentences changed. Compare the analysis on the Result tab.

workspace.humanizeProseHint: The letter stays intact. Only changed phrases are marked. Hover a mark to see before and after.
workspace.panelIdleHint: Runs automatically after generate as a check. Use the button to retry on failure or regenerate.

featuresPage.title: Features
featuresPage.pageDesc: Collect experiences, write against a job posting, then polish the draft. We do not invent work you did not do.

library.title: Experience library
library.lead: Keep the stories you will use in cover letters in one place. Fill role, description, and outcomes—not just a title.
points: Save each project or role as one experience. Merge similar items; split different angles.
You can split a story into situation, task, action, and result. Leave numbers blank if you do not have them.
If the description is too short, the status shows that it needs more detail before generation.
You can store up to 30 experiences.

job.title: Job posting analysis
job.lead: Bring in the posting you are applying to. Required skills and keywords are extracted for writing.
points: Import from a hiring-site URL, pasted text, or a PDF/image. If the image is hard to read, use text or a URL.
Keep duties, requirements, and plus-factors. You can drop apply buttons and privacy notices.
If you share a posting, other signed-in users can write against it.
The public calendar shows only title, company, and deadline—not the job description.

workspace.title: AI workspace
workspace.lead: Keep the posting and your experiences on one screen. Draft, review, and interview questions follow in the same place.
points: When the posting changes, matching experiences are suggested from company, role, and posting text.
Set section titles and target length so paragraphs follow that order and size.
Deep-dive experiences are split across questions. The same scene is not repeated.
If evidence is missing, generation says so. It does not invent careers.
After a draft, you can run review, keyword compare, and likely interview questions.
When writing is done, you can soften AI-sounding sentences. Facts and numbers stay the same.

style.title: Writing style
style.lead: Check tone and sentence length on a saved letter or pasted text.
points: Shows frequent phrases, sentence length, and whether formal speech is used.
It is not used as generation material. Use it to review your own writing.

calendar.title: Job calendar
calendar.lead: Shared deadlines are public. Your own posting deadlines appear after you sign in.
points: Shared postings show only title, company, and deadline.
Select a day to see which postings close that day.
The My postings calendar is visible only to you.
Job descriptions and private drafts are not published.

tools.title: Guides and tools
tools.lead: Before you sign up, you can read how to split an experience and use a character counter.
points: The writing form is situation, task, action, and result. Saving needs an account.
Character counts stay on this device and are not sent to the server.
Full essay answers are not provided.

about.title: About
body: ResumePilot stores an experience library, analyzes job postings, recommends matching experiences, and generates or reviews letters.
The AI does not invent your experience. If evidence is missing it says so.
This is a personal project. There is no business registration or mail-order license number.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.desc: How account and writing data are used.
body: We store signup email and a password stored so it cannot be read back, profile fields, experiences, postings, letter text, sign-in session info, and AI usage logs.
Purpose: sign-in, tailored writing, operations. Ads may appear only on public guide/tool pages, never beside a private letter.
Deleting an account removes that user’s data. Review share links last 7 days or until revoked.
Generation may send needed text to the configured AI provider. An ad script loads on public pages only when a client id is configured.
Contact uses the contact page. If no operator email is published, we do not invent one.

terms.title: Terms
body: The product is free. Paid plans are not offered yet.
You are responsible for checking facts before submitting. Do not claim work you did not do.
Do not publish someone else’s posting or letter, and do not index share links in search.
The service may change or pause. There is no warranty beyond a personal project.
